Definition: feminine of G1401; a female slave (involuntarily or voluntarily):--handmaid(-en).
BiblicalUsage: A female servant, a handmaid, as Mary called herself the handmaid of the Lord when the angel brought her the news, and she sang that God had regarded the low estate of His handmaiden. Joel's promise, quoted at Pentecost, is that God will pour out His Spirit on His servants and handmaidens.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God chooses handmaidens for His greatest work, and Mary's low estate was no barrier to His favour. The Spirit falls on servants and handmaidens alike, and that is the church I belong to.
